decision_rationale: Estimated local runtime on Apple Silicon M2 MPS for the full historical corpus (8692 events × 3 seeds) is ~87.3 minutes (~69.9 minutes excluding already-frozen 2024-2025). Under the Phase 13 decision protocol, jobs within the 30-120 minute window strictly prefer local execution unless inconvenient, completely avoiding cloud VM boot overhead, network authentication, and unnecessary cloud expenditure. Preemption-safe sharded cloud execution on NVIDIA L4 Spot remains fully implemented and available in reserve.
